texts.label: text
texts.orig: When people ask me where they should try to go work, outside of rolling the dice on the next rocket ship, I encourage them to find the company that (1) is best at teaching them the craft of product management and (2) has a track record of creating an inflection in the careers of the PMs who’ve worked there. The problem is, I’ve never really known which companies do this. Until now.
